name_reason: Fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix + audio domain + descriptor that reflects both purpose (per-chapter enemy-turn BGM track ids) and data type (a byte lookup table). No Ghidra address residue. The implicit chapter dimension (30 = chapters 1..30) is a meaningful domain count, not address residue.
purpose: Per-chapter enemy-turn BGM track-id lookup table: byte[30] indexed by chapter id (0..29), giving the FDMUS track to play during the enemy's turn.
logic_summary: Read-only const table consumed only by fd2_run_full_turn_cycle. Indexed by data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id via MOVZX byte ptr [chapter_id + 0x51E81] (unsigned, stride 1). Used two ways: (1) compared against the player-turn table data_fd2_audio_per_chapter_player_turn_bgm_track (@0x51E63) at the enemy-turn-open and new-player-turn boundaries to decide whether to fade the current BGM out; (2) passed to fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade(track,0) to start the enemy-turn BGM.
element_semantics: Each element is an 8-bit FDMUS music track id; element index i corresponds to chapter (i+1). Observed values: tracks 0x01, 0x04, 0x06, 0x08, 0x0c. Read with MOVZX (zero-extended, unsigned).
notes: Verified against Ghidra: memory bytes 0c0c010c060c0c0106040c010c01060c080c0c060c06080c060108010108 byte-identical to the src array. get_xrefs_to(0x51e81) = exactly 3 reads, all from fd2_run_full_turn_cycle (0x1a50e fade-cmp vs player table at enemy-turn open; 0x1a57a track for fd2_set_bgm_track_with_fade enemy-turn; 0x1a5b2 fade-cmp vs player table at new-player-turn). Zero writers -> const confirmed. Disasm confirms MOVZX byte ptr [EAX(=chapter_id) + 0x51e81] at all three sites. src comment already accurate and precise (comment kept, audtab.c untouched). Ghidra data plate was null -> created concise plate consistent with src conclusion (data plate written via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism). The player-turn table src comment lists extra readers, but that is the neighbouring 0x51E63 table's documentation, not this symbol's; this symbol's comment correctly states 'consumed by fd2_run_full_turn_cycle' only.
